summary: Frontend E2E testing of PHP app (Dominik Łakomy - Pogotowie Komputerowe) in FLATTENED public_html layout at http://127.0.0.1:9096/. Verified open_basedir/require bug fix: bootstrap locator resolves app/bootstrap.php correctly from public_html root. All critical flows pass 100%: homepage renders with dark theme + CSS 200 OK, booking end-to-end creates PK-2026-0003 with token, status lookup returns 'Oczekuje na potwierdzenie', admin login redirects to /admin/index.php, appointments and availability pages load without PHP warnings.

issues: Uses native browser date/time inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than a localized PL date picker — acceptable for admin but inconsistent with locale pl-PL

critical_code_review_comments: Bootstrap locator pattern (checking ['/app/bootstrap.php','/../app/bootstrap.php','/../../app/bootstrap.php']) is robust for shared hosting variants — good defensive design.
seed_data_creation: Created booking PK-2026-0003 with token 0de24b4e22d0... on 2026-09-24 10:00 during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flattened public_html layout confirmed working. Slot 10:00 on 2026-09-24 was used by this test; next iteration should use 10:30 or add availability via /admin/availability.php.
rca of the issue: Original open_basedir error caused by fixed '../app/bootstrap.php' path that pointed outside public_html on shared hosts where DocumentRoot IS public_html. Fix uses a candidate-path locator that tries ./app, ../app, ../../app — works in both flattened and classic layouts. Verified no 'Warning: require()', no 'open_basedir', no 'Fatal error' on any tested page.
